text: The Contractor is entitled to an extension of the Time for Completion if and to the extent that completion is or will be delayed by: a Variation; an Exceptional Event under Clause 19; unforeseeable physical conditions under Sub-Clause 4.5; a delay caused by the Owner or its other contractors; or a change in law under Sub-Clause 14.4; in each case subject to Clause 22. Concurrent delays caused by the Contractor are taken into account.
title: Extension of Time
